message.content:
The **login page** for PreLicenseTraining.com is the site’s account login at `prelicensetraining.com/login`.[1]

- To sign in, enter your **login name** and **password**.[1]
- The site notes that your **login name may be your email address**.[1]
- If you forgot your password, use the **Forgot Password** page to reset it by entering your email address.[2]

If you want, I can also help you find the **student login**, **mentor login**, or **password reset** page specifically.
